Elaine (Marketing): Quick heads up 9 planning to publish the Optimize playbook next Wed 10:00 AM PT. Need legal signoff + CEO quote by EOD Tue. Draft in /marketing/drafts.

Mike (PR): Suggest embargo at 9:30 AM PT, short press kit and one-pager. I can run reporter outreach. Who wants the embargoed PDF? :memo:

Nora (Legal): I7ll scan for any superlatives. Please replace 'industry-leading' with specific p95 numbers or remove. Add a brief footnote about benchmark conditions.

Samir (Product): Chart uploaded to /marketing/assets/optimize-chart.png. Footnote: "Benchmarks on standard harness; customer results may vary."

DevOps (Infra): Analytics ID 1284 ready. Publish webhook: https://hooks.redwood.ai/publish. Tell me the publish job ID and I'll wire tracking.

PressOps Bot: Publish job created: channel=marketing/blog, publish_at=2026-04-01T17:00:00Z, embargo_until=2026-04-01T16:30:00Z, job_id=98421.

Elaine (Marketing): Perfect. Nora please drop a thumbs-up when legal signs off. Mike will you paste final press list here before EOD Tue?

Mike (PR): Will do. Drafting embargoed email now.

Nora (Legal): :thumbsup: all good from legal, removed unsubstantiated claims and added the footnote.

Samir (Product): :thumbsup:

DevOps (Infra): :thumbsup: analytics wired, webhook validated.

Elaine (Marketing): :thumbsup: Thanks team — announce channels will go live with the blog link. If anything blocks, flag here.
